jsesh.mdc.model
Class ModelElementDeepAdapter

java.lang.Object
  jsesh.mdc.model.ModelElementDeepAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
ModelElementVisitor
Direct Known Subclasses:
RTFExporter.RTFExporterAux
public class ModelElementDeepAdapter
extends java.lang.Object
implements ModelElementVisitor

A convenience base class form ModelElementVisitors.

Visit methods for non abstract classes call the methods for their abstract parents, which in turn call the methods for their parents, which call visitDefault.

visitDefault call accept on all children.

This architecture allows you to customize your visitor at the precision you want.

Author:
S. Rosmorduc
